title: Answer: no account of intelligence, only of the scale at which brains and networks work

statements.text: Causal emergence takes no position on what intelligence is. Its sources ask instead at which scale brains and learning machines do their causal work: complex, multilevel systems such as brains are likely to work at a macro level, because selection in biology must deal with unpredictability and produces degeneracy. The same question of intrinsic scale is raised for whether the brain works at the scale of neurons or minicolumns, and for which level of abstraction suits the modeling of deep neural networks.
statements.scope: Quantifying causal emergence (2013) and Emergence as the conversion of information (2021)
